title: oenothera multijuga var. parviflora
intro: Oenothera multijuga var. parviflora, commonly known as the small-flowered evening primrose, is a plant species belonging to the family Onagraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera multijuga var. parviflora are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
